facts.fact: L'Essor reports that Mali's Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (APDP) issued a communique dated 5 September 2024 warning that publishing personal data online risks fines of FCFA 5 to 20 million, so the body is in place and acting.
facts.system: Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (APDP)

note: No ruling against a named organisation or yearly figures: the communique is a general warning.
